title: The Case of the Golden Idol: The Fall
alt: At dusk a man in a green coat and a three-cornered hat stands at the edge of a cliff with his arms out. A second man falls backward off the edge in front of the low sun, and his hat and papers fly away. A small gold statue glows on a crate near a tent, and a ship is at anchor on the sea.
summary: A painting of a scene from The Case of the Golden Idol in {strokes} brush strokes, with a playback of each stroke.
text: This is the first death in The Case of the Golden Idol, a game by Color Gray Games. The year is 1742. Albert Cloudsley pushes Oberon Geller off a cliff on an island.
The golden idol stands on a crate near their camp, and their ship is at anchor below. The painting has {strokes} brush strokes.
